input.summary: Add express performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy and carve it out of the AS IS disclaimer
input.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently provided wholly \"AS IS\" with no conformance warranty or remedy, which we cannot accept; we have added a 12-month conformance warranty for the Software, a workmanlike-services and no-malicious-code warranty, and a repair/replace/refund remedy, and carved these out of the disclaimer. If helpful, we can fall back to a ninety (90) day software warranty period.
